description_en: Queries the log information of an IPsec-VPN connection by calling the DescribeVpnConnections operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnConnections接口查询IPsec连接的日志信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-connection-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-m5evqnds4y459flt30000 --from 1671003744 --to 1671004344 --minute-period 10 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tunnel-id tun-opsqc4d97wni270000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnConnectionLogs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1671003744 represents 2022-12-14 15:42:24.

> If you specify **From**, you must also specify **To** or **MinutePeriod**
parameters.help_zh:
日志起始时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1671003744，1671003744表示的时间为2022年12月14日15:42:24。

> 如果指定**From**，则必须指定**To**或**MinutePeriod**
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1671004344 represents 2022-12-14 15:52:24.

> If you specify **To**, you must also specify **From** or **MinutePeriod**
parameters.help_zh:
日志结束时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1671004344，1671004344表示的时间为2022年12月14日15:52:24。

> 如果指定**To**，则必须指定**From**或**MinutePeriod**
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en:
The log period. Valid values: **1** to **10**. Unit: minutes.

> If you do not specify **From** or **To**, you must specify **MinutePeriod**
parameters.help_zh:
日志周期。取值范围：**1**~**10**。单位：分钟。

> 如果不指定**From**和**To**，则必须指定**MinutePeriod**
parameters.name: minute_period

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**50**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The tunnel ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

This parameter is supported only for IPsec-VPN connections in dual-tunnel mode
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接的隧道ID。

仅双隧道模式的IPsec连接支持配置该项
parameters.name: tunnel_id
